message.jaymospowers.fishing.line_broke: The line snapped and the fish got away.
message.jaymospowers.fishing.too_big: Too big for this rod - it broke free.
message.jaymospowers.fishing.shark_lande: Landed a %2$s kg shark and cut it up on the shore: %1$s.
message.jaymospowers.fishing.bare_hook: Nothing will bite a bare hook. Sneak and use the rod with bait in your other hand.
message.jaymospowers.fishing.lure_needs_: A lure needs a spinning rod or a sea rod to work it.
message.jaymospowers.fishing.groundbait: Groundbait in the water: fish round here will be keener for a while.
tooltip.jaymospowers.rod.cane_pole: Small fish only, but they bite quickly
tooltip.jaymospowers.rod.spinning_rod: Works lures; for the fish that chase them
tooltip.jaymospowers.rod.ledger_rod: Bait on the bottom: draws fish from farther off
tooltip.jaymospowers.lure: Lure: stays on the line (spinning or sea rod)
tooltip.jaymospowers.bait: Bait: sneak and use a rod with this in your other hand
